# docker_info (Data Source)

Reads daemon and host information from the provider's Docker host (`GET /info`), like `docker info`. Use `info` for fields such as the swarm state, storage driver, CPU count and registry configuration.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "docker_info" "host" {}

output "daemon" {
  value = {
    id             = data.docker_info.host.id
    name           = data.docker_info.host.name
    cpus           = data.docker_info.host.info.ncpu
    storage_driver = data.docker_info.host.info.driver
    swarm_state    = data.docker_info.host.info.swarm.local_node_state
  }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Read-Only

- `content_sha256` (String) sha256 of info_json.
- `docker_server_version` (String) Docker Engine version from GET /version.
- `engine_api_version` (String) Engine API version negotiated with the daemon (min of the client maximum and GET /version ApiVersion).
- `id` (String) Daemon ID (`ID` in `GET /info`).
- `info` (Attributes) The GET /info response as a nested object, field by field. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--info))
- `info_json` (String) The Engine API GET /info response as JSON. Re-encoded, not byte-exact: the moby client keeps no raw body for this call, so this is the decoded response written as canonical JSON (keys sorted, compact).
- `name` (String) Host name of the daemon (`Name` in `GET /info`).
